issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]、タオルを新[あたら]しいものに{お取[と]り替[か]えします|kg-o-suru}。
issues.problem: why referred to 'the guest' although the sentence addresses 先生/the professor.
issues.action: Rewrote why to match the sentence.

issues.jp_before: お近所[きんじょ]の皆[みな]さんに、旅行[りょこう]のお土産[みやげ]を{お配[くば]りします|kg-o-suru}。
issues.problem: お近所 is wrong; the standard honorific form is ご近所.
issues.action: Changed お近所 to ご近所.

issues.jp_before: お忙[いそが]しい中[なか]、工場[こうじょう]を{取材[しゅざい]させていただき|kg-sasete}、ありがとうございました。
issues.problem: Without an owner for the factory, the distractor 取材してくださり also works (the factory could be thanking the reporters); only the English decided it.
issues.action: Added 御社の before 工場 so the sentence itself shows the speaker is the reporter.

issues.jp_before: 来週[らいしゅう]、先生[せんせい]の研究室[けんきゅうしつ]に{訪問[ほうもん]させていただきます|kg-sasete}。
issues.problem: 訪問する takes を for the place visited; 研究室に訪問 is a common error.

issues.jp_before: 運転手[うんてんしゅ]さんに、駅[えき]の前[まえ]で{降[お]ろしていただきました|kg-teitadaku}。
issues.problem: Distractor 降[お]らせていただきました is not a real word with that reading (降らせる is read ふらせる).
issues.action: Replaced it with 降[お]ろさせていただきました, which is well-formed and wrong.

issues.jp_before: 先輩[せんぱい]に、車[くるま]で空港[くうこう]まで{乗[の]せていただきました|kg-teitadaku}。
issues.problem: Distractor 乗らせていただきました ('I was allowed to ride') gives almost the same meaning as the English (my senior gave me a ride).
issues.action: Replaced it with 乗[の]せさせていただきました ('I was allowed to give a ride'), which is plainly wrong.

issues.jp_before: ホテルの方[かた]に、タクシーを{呼[よ]んでいただきました|kg-teitadaku}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate frame: three items open with ホテルの方に.
issues.action: Changed the giver to フロントの方 and the English to 'front desk staff'.

issues.jp_before: 狭[せま]い通路[つうろ]なので、少[すこ]し{空[あ]けていただけませんか|kg-teitadaku}。
issues.problem: 空ける has no object, so the sentence is unclear and unnatural.
issues.action: Added 道を (少し道を空けていただけませんか).

issues.jp_before: お会計[かいけい]は全部[ぜんぶ]で三千五百円[さんぜんごひゃくえん]{でございます|kg-gozaimasu}。
issues.problem: Distractor でございました is acceptable: cashiers do say this confirming-past form for the total.
issues.action: Replaced the distractor with でおります and updated why.

issues.jp_before: 恐[おそ]れ入[い]りますが、あちらに両替[りょうがえ]の機械[きかい]が{ございます|kg-gozaimasu}。
issues.problem: 恐れ入りますが leads into a request or an imposition, so it is odd before a plain statement of where something is.
issues.action: Rewrote as お客様、両替の機械はあちらにございます。 with matching English.

issues.jp_before: お持[も]ち帰[かえ]り{でございますか|kg-gozaimasu}。
issues.problem: Using でございますか for the customer's own matter is widely flagged as bad keigo; the model phrase is お持ち帰りですか. Not a good sentence to model.
issues.action: Replaced with the phone greeting お電話ありがとうございます。山田書店でございます。 (same skill, 3 distractors).

issues.jp_before: この店[みせ]は、創業[そうぎょう]百年[ひゃくねん]の老舗[しにせ]{でございます|kg-gozaimasu}。
issues.problem: Staff speaking about their own shop in formal speech would say 当店, not この店.
issues.action: Changed to 当店は and the English to 'Our shop'.

issues.jp_before: お取[と]り置[お]きの商品[しょうひん]は、レジの奥[おく]に{ございます|kg-gozaimasu}。
issues.problem: The English was inaccurate ('at the back of the register' for レジの奥; お取り置き means the shop is holding the item).
issues.action: Changed the English to 'The item we are holding for you is behind the register.'

issues.jp_before: {お風呂[ふろ]|kg-bika}に入[はい]ると、体[からだ]が温[あたた]まります。
issues.problem: why said 風呂 is a Chinese-origin reading, which is doubtful (the kanji are ateji).
issues.action: Rewrote why: お風呂 is a fixed everyday word that always takes お.
